verdict_ungated.status: VERDICT NOT GATED -- DO NOT CITE THIS NUMBER AS VALIDATED
verdict_ungated.verdict_field_left_UNEDITED: The verdict above still reads ATLAS_BEATS_THERMODYNAMIC because that is what the code mechanically returned. This block withdraws the READING, not the record.
verdict_ungated.why: The bar's shuffled-label validity control FAILED and the gate could not fire. Measured null median over 10 seeds: 0.0203 against a bar of |median| < 0.02 -- outside it by 0.0003. The verdict function's clause read `abs(med(null) - med(gc)) < MARGIN`, i.e. |0.0203 - 0.3112| = 0.2909, which is never below 0.02, so INVALID_NULL_SCORED was unreachable. The single most consequential line in the check order could not execute.
verdict_ungated.the_bar_text_is_also_wrong: The bar says `|median gain over GC| < 0.02`, which would require the shuffled-label model to be as GOOD as GC -- the opposite of the intent. Its derivation clause and the sibling fragment arm it inherits from both plainly mean the null must score NEAR ZERO. The corrected kernel applies that reading, which is the STRICTER one: it is the reading under which this run's own null fails. The bar's text is NOT re-worded, because a frozen bar is not edited after a result.

verdict_ungated.why_the_numbers_will_probably_reproduce: The arm is deterministic (0.00e+00), the seeds and splits are fixed and verified, and the corrected run changes only the null's seed count and the gate's arithmetic. So the substantive question is entirely whether a 270-seed pooled null clears |median| < 0.02 -- NOT whether 0.5076 moves. Saying so in advance is the point: it is a prediction the next run tests, not a reassurance.
verdict_ungated.leading_alternative_explanation_NOT_excl: Corpus-selection exposure. The pretraining corpus holds 66 Escherichia/Shigella assemblies including BL21(DE3) and B str. REL606, and the corpus is described as regulatory sequences EXTRACTED FROM GenBank -- i.e. plausibly upstream-of-gene regions. If so, 'this sequence resembles what was selected into my pretraining corpus' is itself a proxy for 'this is a real promoter', which correlates with measured expression. That is not label leakage, and it is not excluded either. Distinguishing it needs the corpus sequences (a 2.3 GB h5 or the 3,371 FASTAs), which were not downloaded.
